testCase.name: Manifest Permission Missing
testCase.description: SecurityException due to missing CAMERA permission

error.message: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA

agent_response.error: java.lang.SecurityException: Permission denial: starting Intent requires android.permission.CAMERA
fixGuidelines:
1. File: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml at line 5
   Add the permission declaration right after the manifest tag.

2. Before:
```
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.example.app">
</manifest>
```
After:
```
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    package="com.example.app">
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.CAMERA" />
</manifest>
```
3. Verify by running the app again and checking if it grants the necessary permissions during runtime.

testCase.name: Gradle Network Failure
testCase.description: Failed to resolve dependency due to network/repository issue

error.message: Could not resolve all dependencies for configuration :classpath

metadata.context: Repository not accessible or dependency missing

expectedFix.explanation: Add missing repository or check network connection

agent_response.error: Could not resolve all dependencies for configuration :classpath
agent_response.rootCause: This error is not a common pattern
fixGuidelines: 1. Check if build.gradle.kts contains the correct Google Maven repositories configuration and ensure they are accessible from the project's location.

2. Before:
```kotlin
// Example of incorrect or missing repository configuration in build.gradle.kts
implementation "com.google.android:DKM:1.5"
implementation "com.google.android:DKM:1.6"
```
After:
```kotlin
// Correct Google Maven repositories configuration with alternative mirrors if necessary
implementation "com.google.android:DKM:1.5"
implementation "com.google.android:DKM:1.6"
implementation "https://dl1.maven.org/dl android/maven2"
```
3. Verify that all required AndroidX dependencies are included in the build.gradle.kts file and properly listed with their respective Maven repositories.
4. Check if there are any firewall rules or network restrictions blocking access to Google's Maven repositories from the project's location.
5. Ensure that the build.gradle.kts file is correctly configured with all necessary repository information, including alternative mirrors if available.
6. Test the fix by rebuilding the project and observing if the error persists.
7. If the issue remains unresolved, consider verifying the integrity of the Maven repositories or seeking alternative dependency sources.

testCase.name: ProGuard Rule Missing
testCase.description: Runtime crash in release build due to obfuscation

metadata.context: Gson reflection methods removed by R8

expectedFix.explanation: Add ProGuard keep rule for serialization classes

agent_response.rootCause: ProGuard in build.gradle.kts line 28 (minifyEnabled=true) removes method getUserName() from User class at User.kt line 45, causing NoSuchMethodError at runtime in MainActivity.kt line 102.
fixGuidelines: 1. Edit proguard-rules.pro at line 15: Add -keep class com.example.User { public java.lang.String getUserName(); } to preserve method
2. Disable minification for debug builds in build.gradle.kts line 28: buildTypes { debug { isMinifyEnabled = false } release { isMinifyEnabled = true } }
3. Verify: Run ./gradlew assembleRelease and check build/outputs/mapping/release/usage.txt to confirm getUserName() is not removed, test at MainActivity.kt line 102
